summary: US Operation Epic Fury entered its fifth night with major airstrikes targeting Iranian coastal surveillance, air defense sites, and military logistics infrastructure across multiple provinces. Iran responded with ballistic missile launches from Bushehr and Kermanshah toward the Gulf, striking US 5th Fleet headquarters in Bahrain and destroying HIMARS launchers in Kuwait. Regional escalation expanded with explosions reported in Dubai, Qatar air defense activation, and Pakistani forces in Saudi Arabia placed on alert for potential anti-Houthi operations.
key_points: CENTCOM confirmed a major wave of US airstrikes against Iranian coastal surveillance, air defense sites, and military logistics infrastructure overnight. (Source: @shin_persian/8011)
IRGC claimed destruction of HIMARS launchers in Kuwait and drone/missile strikes on US positions in Bahrain, killing US special forces personnel. (Source: @presstv/199130)
Iran launched five missiles from Jam, Bushehr province toward the Gulf at 02:56-02:57 local time, triggering Kuwaiti and Bahraini air defenses. (Source: @VahidOnline/77171)
US strikes hit the Bandar Abbas-Shiraz bridge, Bushehr, and Iranshahr airport, with Iranian reports of seven dead. (Source: @almogboker78/17730)
Satellite imagery confirmed destruction of a Halliburton logistics warehouse at Kuwait's Abdullah Port by Iranian drones. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83610)
Explosions were reported in Dubai, UAE, while Qatar recorded explosion sounds and air defense activation in Doha. (Source: @inon_yttach/9507, @VahidOnline/77174)
Pakistani forces deployed in Saudi Arabia were placed on alert for possible participation against Houthis in Yemen. (Source: @pkpoi/143318)
UK designated IRGC as a terrorist organization under the National Security Act, imposing up to 14 years imprisonment for support. (Source: @shin_persian/8029)

sections.executive_summary: US Operation Epic Fury intensified with a confirmed major wave of airstrikes targeting Iranian coastal surveillance, air defense, and military logistics infrastructure across multiple provinces. Iran retaliated with ballistic missile salvos from Bushehr and Kermanshah, striking the US 5th Fleet headquarters in Bahrain and destroying HIMARS systems in Kuwait, while US strikes hit critical Iranian transport infrastructure including the Bandar Abbas-Shiraz bridge. Regional spillover accelerated with explosions in Dubai, air defense activation in Qatar, and Pakistani forces in Saudi Arabia readied for potential anti-Houthi combat operations.

points: US CENTCOM confirmed a major wave of airstrikes overnight targeting Iranian coastal surveillance systems, air defense sites, and military logistics infrastructure across the country. (Source: @shin_persian/8011)

Iranian ballistic missile launches were reported from Jam, Bushehr province (five missiles at 02:56-02:57 local time toward the Gulf) and from Paveh, Kermanshah province at 0647Z. (Source: @VahidOnline/77171, @shin_persian/8018)

US strikes hit the strategic Gariyeh and Kuhestan bridges in Bandar Khamir, part of the main Bandar Abbas-Shiraz route, killing seven and injuring nine per Hormozgan governorate. (Source: @VahidOnline/77177)

Additional US targets included Bushehr, Iranshahr airport, Chabahar maritime surveillance tower (which collapsed), and Semnan Airport control facility in northern Iran (coordinates 35.5947944, 53.4951494). (Source: @almogboker78/17730, @VahidOnline/77182, @shin_persian/8030)
Iranian authorities requested citizens to reduce electricity consumption amid ongoing conflict. (Source: @New_security8200/202705)
UK Home Office designated IRGC under National Security (State Threats) Act, criminalizing support with up to 14 years imprisonment and life for sabotage. (Source: @shin_persian/8029)
Israeli forces eliminated a Hamas company commander in Gaza who served as Mohammed Deif's deputy, held hostages, and documented their release ceremonies. (Source: @N12chat/217858)
An Israeli drone strike west of Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza killed one Palestinian and wounded several others. (Source: @presstv/199138)
IDF launched an interceptor missile at a false identification over southern Gaza Strip; no sirens sounded and no actual attack occurred, incident under investigation. (Source: @manniefabian/58800)
Israeli drone strike west of Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza killed one Palestinian and wounded several others. (Source: @presstv/199138)
Hamas company commander eliminated in Gaza; identified as close aide to Mohammed Deif, responsible for hostage holding and release ceremony documentation. (Source: @N12chat/217858)
IDF interceptor launched at false identification over southern Gaza; military confirmed no actual threat, no sirens activated, investigation ongoing. (Source: @manniefabian/58800)
Red Alert Lebanon volunteer recruitment drive announced seeking volunteers for publishing team with minimum three hours daily availability and stable internet. (Source: @redlinkleb/31642)
Unknown warplanes flew at low altitude over Soran district in Erbil province, Iraq. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83603)
Pakistani forces stationed in Saudi Arabia placed on high alert and preparing for possible participation in combat against Houthis in Yemen if regional escalation continues. (Source: @pkpoi/143318)

IRGC claimed destruction of HIMARS launchers and missiles in Kuwait, plus drone and missile strikes on multiple US force positions and US-Israeli-backed anti-Iran groups, killing numerous fighters and US special forces. (Source: @presstv/199130)
Satellite imagery confirmed complete destruction of Halliburton logistics warehouse at Kuwait's Abdullah Port industrial area after Iranian drone attack earlier today. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83610)
Satellite images show new damage at US 5th Fleet headquarters in Bahrain; a probable communications antenna struck during recent Iranian attacks. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83612)
Kuwait Army General Staff announced air defense systems engaging Iranian missile and drone attacks; explosions heard from interceptions. (Source: @VahidOnline/77171)
Bahrain Interior Ministry activated warning sirens, directed citizens to nearest safe locations after Iran announced targeting US 5th Fleet in Bahrain. (Source: @VahidOnline/77171)
Explosions reported in Dubai, UAE per local reports; Qatar recorded explosion and air defense sounds in Doha at 04:10, threat eliminated by 04:23. (Source: @inon_yttach/9507, @VahidOnline/77174)
HIMARS launch platform caught fire on Kuwait-Iraq border following Iranian attacks yesterday. (Source: @naya_foriraq/83606)

sections.threat_assessment: The conflict has entered a dangerous escalation cycle with direct state-on-state kinetic exchanges between US and Iranian forces across multiple Gulf theaters. Iran's demonstrated ability to strike US naval headquarters in Bahrain and destroy HIMARS systems in Kuwait indicates significant missile/drone capability retention despite sustained US strikes. The expansion of effects to Dubai, Qatar, and potential Pakistani involvement in Yemen signals high risk of uncontrolled regional widening. US targeting of Iranian transport infrastructure (bridges, ports, airports) aims to degrade logistics but risks hardening Iranian resolve to maintain Strait of Hormuz leverage. The false identification intercept over Gaza suggests heightened Israeli air defense sensitivity amid multi-front tensions.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are activating layered air defenses: Kuwait engaging inbound missiles/drones, Bahrain sounding civilian sirens, Qatar clearing a security threat in Doha. Pakistan's preparation for anti-Houthi operations from Saudi territory indicates Riyadh seeking broader coalition support against Iranian-backed proxies. Russia's Lavrov maintains diplomatic contact with all Gulf crisis parties while criticizing US aggression as undermining pre-existing navigation freedoms. UK's IRGC terrorist designation adds legal-financial pressure on Iranian networks. The Halliburton warehouse destruction in Kuwait demonstrates Iranian willingness to target US commercial-military logistics nodes, likely prompting enhanced base hardening across GCC states.
sections.intelligence_notes: Key intelligence gaps include: exact battle damage assessment on Iranian air defense degradation from US strikes; Iranian missile inventory remaining after multiple salvo launches; US 5th Fleet operational status post-strike; Houthi command-and-control resilience if Pakistani forces engage. The Semnan Airport control tower strike (northern Iran) suggests US targeting depth beyond southern coastal facilities. Iranian electricity conservation appeals indicate infrastructure strain. UKMTO Warning 088-26 implies ongoing maritime threat to commercial shipping. Monitoring should focus on: Iranian missile reload rates; US tanker-supported fighter deployment patterns; GCC air defense interceptor expenditure; Houthi attack tempo on Saudi oil infrastructure.
